## Pull request overview

Refactors the `examples/msw-todo` stack definition to match the repository’s standard `ObjectStackDefinition` shape by moving app-level metadata into `apps: [App.create(...)]` and adding a top-level `manifest` block, aligning this example with other example apps.

**Changes:**
- Migrate `examples/msw-todo/objectstack.config.ts` to use `apps` + `manifest` (and import `App` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`).
- Update the README snippet in `examples/msw-todo/README.md` to reflect the new config structure.
- Mark the related roadmap task as complete in `ROADMAP.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| examples/msw-todo/objectstack.config.ts | Moves flattened app properties into `apps: [App.create(...)]` and adds `manifest` metadata. |
| examples/msw-todo/README.md | Updates documentation snippet to show `apps`/`manifest` usage. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the MSW config cleanup item as done. |
